title: Owner-authorized track operations foundation
purpose: Introduce owner-authorized private track creation, read, collection read, and metadata update on top of the canonical SeshProjectOwnershipAuthorizer, project CAS, and SESH-070A/B track persistence boundaries.

authorization.rule: Authorization must succeed before track persistence is read or mutated.

projectInvariant.create: Server-created track id is attached through project compare-and-swap.
projectInvariant.read: Track must remain attached to the authorized project.
projectInvariant.list: Only tracks represented by the current canonical project trackIds membership are returned.
projectInvariant.update: Track must remain attached to the authorized project.

compensation.projectAttachmentFailure: Delete the newly created track metadata as compensation.

deferredDeletion.reason: The current SeshTrackRepository exposes unconditional deleteTrack. Owner-authorized deletion remains deferred until revision-gated track deletion is modeled so concurrent track updates cannot be silently destroyed.

boundaries: No R2 or audio-byte authority is added.
No audio asset is attached to or detached from a track.
No public media authority is added.
No copyright, publishing, master, management, licensing, or royalty semantics are added.
